answer_1.quote: We develop "proxy annotators" that complete the tasks comparably to an arbitrary human annotator; we call the method PROXANN.
answer_1.outputs: topic labels, relevance judgments, representativeness rankings

answer_2.quote: the most common unsupervised automated metrics, while fast to compute, are poor measures of topic quality

answer_3.quote: Using both open-source and proprietary large language models (LLMs), we develop "proxy annotators" that complete the tasks comparably to an arbitrary human annotator; we call the method PROXANN.

answer_4.quote: We recruit at least four annotators per topic through Prolific. Low-quality respondents are filtered out with attention checks.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators review exemplar documents and keywords to construct a free-text label, then judge the fit of evaluation documents on a 1-5 scale, and rank documents by representativeness.
